FILE COPY MANAGER - USB DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTIONS
================================================

PORTABLE EXECUTABLE
-------------------
FileCopyManager.exe is a standalone executable that can run directly from a USB drive.
No Python installation or additional dependencies are required on the target computer.

HOW TO USE FROM USB DRIVE
--------------------------
1. Copy FileCopyManager.exe to your USB drive
2. Plug the USB drive into any Windows computer
3. Double-click FileCopyManager.exe to run the application
4. The application will create a config.json file in the same directory to save your settings

IMPORTANT NOTES
---------------
- The config.json file will be created next to the .exe file
- Make sure your USB drive has write permissions if you want to save settings
- The application works on Windows 7 and later (64-bit)
- First launch may take a few seconds as the executable unpacks

FILE SIZE
---------
The executable is approximately 8.2 MB and contains:
- Python runtime
- Tkinter GUI library
- All application code and dependencies

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
- If Windows Defender blocks the app, click "More info" and "Run anyway"
  (This is normal for unsigned executables)
- If the application doesn't start, try running it as administrator
- Make sure the USB drive is not write-protected if you want to save settings

Version: 1.0.1
Built with: PyInstaller 6.16.0
